description: Optional usage alerts: set an alert webhook on your key (PUT /api/v1/usage/alert {"webhook_url"}, MCP set_usage_alert, or your human on /account) and HorseToga POSTs one signed usage.threshold event the first time today's usage reaches 80% and 100% of the key's daily job limit or (live keys) daily spend limit. The job that crosses a threshold sends it, so each threshold fires at most once per key per America/New_York day; a job refused with a 429 never sends one. Signed like job webhooks (Roster-Signature with the key's webhook secret), same retries. Sandbox keys get the same events for $0. Send {"webhook_url": null} to turn alerts off. GET /api/v1/usage shows the setting and today's alerts as alert. The same as PUT /api/v1/usage/alert. Returns the setting and today's alerts.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

webhook_url.description: https URL on a public host for signed usage.threshold events (80% and 100%), or null to turn alerts off.

name: set_usage_alert
title: Set usage alert
